PVIntelligence.description: An AI-driven solar forecasting platform that leverages time-series forecasting (LSTM/GRU), transfer learning, and Explainable AI (SHAP) to accurately predict photovoltaic generation for new solar sites with limited historical data.

SmartML.description: SmartML is an end-to-end AutoML platform that turns raw CSV/Excel/JSON files into trained, benchmarked machine learning models without any code. It features a visual cleaning studio, automated model ranking, AI-powered dataset insights, and deployable exports.

LeakFinder.description: LeakFinder — Executive decision-support platform built for Datathon 2026 (Track 4: The Money Leak). Uncovers negative-margin pricing, stuck pending orders, ad spend leakage, and stockout risks across 5 enterprise tables with transparent, zero-API NumPy data science.

FactGuard-GenAI.description: An automated multi-agent fact-checking framework implementing DeepMind's SAFE (Search-Augmented Factuality Evaluator) architecture to detect and mitigate LLM hallucinations at the atomic claim level.
